args.title: Bellwether Office — Retail returns logistics summary
args.body:
• Bellwether Office’s latest newsletter highlights retail returns logistics and directs readers to its main analysis and companion piece.
• The main article reports apparel return rates of 24% and says consolidated return hubs can reduce handling costs by about 20%.
• The companion piece finds that reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the margin.
